title.zh: 冰法 10-30 级加点指南（演示）

description.zh: 分等级说明冰法升级加点顺序与核心天赋作用。
description.en: Level-by-level Frost mage talent order and what the key talents do.

body.zh: 冰法依赖减速与冻结拉开距离。先点寒冰专注与冰霜护甲，15 级后获得冰锥与急速冷却，20 级后用碎冰放大对冻结目标的伤害。
body.en: Frost relies on slows and freezes to keep distance. Take Frostbolt Focus and Ice Armor first, pick up Cone of Cold and Cold Snap in the teens, then amplify damage on frozen targets with Shatter.

heading.en: Where it works - and where it does not

body.zh: 适合需要风筝的单人场景；不足是站桩爆发偏低。该方案为演示数据，不构成强度承诺。
body.en: Best for solo play where you can kite. Weakness: lower stand-and-deliver burst. This is demo data - no performance claims are made.

provenance.source: Demo fixture authored for tooling development
provenance.notes: Demo guide; must be rewritten against verified data before launch.
